R1.method: Counted number of solids in the STEP file.

R2.method: Intersection volume of part with floor probe box (80x50x2 at z=0) / probe volume. Filled fraction: 1.0000

criteria.condition: solid floor at least 2 mm thick under the whole board area

R3.method: Intersection volume of part with void probe box (80x50x24 at z=8) / probe volume. Empty fraction: 0.0000

criteria.condition: -40 <= x <= 40, -25 <= y <= 25, 8 <= z <= 32 must be completely free of material

R4.method: Measured bounding box dimensions: dx=85.0, dy=55.0, zmax=32.0

criteria.condition: outer size 85 x 55 mm (+-1.5 mm) in X and Y
wall top at z between 30 and 32.5

R5.method: Probed 4 locations at (+-35, +-20). Checked OD (filled fraction), hole (empty fraction), and wall (walled fraction).

criteria.condition: Four screw bosses... OD >= 6mm... pilot hole 2.2mm... depth >= 4mm

R6.method: Probed cutout void (empty fraction: 0.0000) and surrounding wall volume (307.50 mm3).

criteria.condition: USB-C cutout... opening at least 9 mm wide (Y) and 3 mm high (Z)
